diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource uses a local string for function_name, so it can attempt to add permission before :module.cur_per_resource creates the Lambda function. Reference the module's function ARN to establish creation and destruction ordering.

:resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process uses a local string for function_name, so it can attempt to add permission before :module.cur_per_resource_process creates the Lambda function. Reference the module's function ARN to establish creation and destruction ordering.

:resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service uses a local string for function_name, so it can attempt to add permission before :module.cur_per_service creates the Lambda function. Reference the module's function ARN to establish creation and destruction ordering.

:resource.aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification configures the processing Lambda as a destination but does not wait for :resource.aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process. S3 validates destination invocation permissions when installing the notification configuration; add this permission to depends_on alongside the other two permissions.

:resource.aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service depends on the destination bucket but not :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy, which grants the billing/data-exports services permission to check the bucket policy and deliver reports. Wait for the bucket policy before creating the export to avoid destination authorization or delivery failures.

:resource.aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource depends on the destination bucket but not :resource.aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy, which grants the billing/data-exports services permission to check the bucket policy and deliver reports. Wait for the bucket policy before creating the export to avoid destination authorization or delivery failures.
